alternatives.name: Require libraries to use dataclass directly
alternatives.description: Instead of dataclass_transform, require all dataclass-like libraries (attrs, Pydantic) to use @dataclass internally.
alternatives.reason_rejected: These libraries have different semantics and features that don't map cleanly to @dataclass. Forcing them into that mold would limit their functionality.

alternatives.name: Per-library type checker plugins
alternatives.description: Let each library maintain its own type checker plugin (mypy plugin, pyright plugin) for special handling.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Plugins are fragile, hard to maintain across type checker versions, and create an uneven experience. A standard decorator provides a stable interface.
